content:
For the perk found in Nuclear Winter, see Nuclear Winter perks.

“Carry light and run fast.”

**Gun Runner** is an Agility-based perk in *Fallout 76*.

Increased running speed when having a pistol equipped.

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★★ | 2 | Your running speed is increased by 20% when you have a ranged weapon equipped. | 0025A7AA | 
| ★ | 1 | Your running speed is increased by 10% when you have a ranged weapon equipped. | 0025A7A9 | 

- The weapon must be equipped for this perk to take effect.
- The player character's speed is capped at a 50% increase from all sources, meaning Squad Maneuvers and Speed Demon can stack with each other.
